units.source_text: 却说在贺茂神社当斋院的槿姬，为了父亲桃园式部卿亲王逝世，辞职移居他处守孝。

en.t: Now Princess Asagao, who had served as the priestess at Kamo Shrine, resigned and moved elsewhere to observe mourning after the death of her father, Prince Momozono Shikibukyo.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣向有一旦钟情、永不忘怀之癖，故自闻讯后屡次去信吊慰。

en.t: The Inner Minister Genji had always had the habit that once he set his heart on someone, he could never forget her, so after hearing the news he repeatedly sent letters of condolence.

units.source_text: 槿姬回思以前曾经被他爱慕，受他烦扰，故并不给他诚恳的复信，源氏内大臣大为遗憾。

en.t: Princess Asagao remembered how he had once loved her and troubled her with his attentions, and therefore did not send him any sincere reply, which deeply disappointed the Inner Minister Genji.

units.source_text: 到了九月里，槿姬迁居旧宅桃园宫邸。

en.t: In the ninth month, Princess Asagao moved into her former residence, the Momozono Palace.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣闻此消息，心念姑母五公主也住在桃园宫邸，

en.t: When the Inner Minister Genji heard this news, he thought that his aunt, the Fifth Princess, also lived at the Momozono Palace,

units.source_text: 便以探望五公主为借口，前去访问。

en.t: and so, using a visit to the Fifth Princess as his pretext, he went there to call.
